asked.item: Do I have to pay again to get in?
Canceled screen shows while Billing says ACTIVE
How to get back into the dashboard

verdict.reason: The help pages directly cover a canceled screen shown while Billing reads ACTIVE, and say not to pay again and what to do instead.

steps.text: If Billing shows your subscription as ACTIVE but you still see the canceled or reactivate screen, do not pay again.
The lock screen can be stale in your browser.
Then log in again at my.blotato.com/login with your account email spelled in all lowercase.
